title: Regularity of asymptotically axisymmetric Navier–Stokes solutions with analytic forcing
abstract: A Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of the main results of Constantin, Ignatova and Vicol on the regularity of asymptotically axisymmetric solutions of the three-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations with analytic forcing (arXiv:2609.20803). A suitable weak solution on the unit parabolic cylinder, smooth before the blow-up time, whose force is bounded in C^2 up to the blow-up time and real analytic in space, whose angular mean satisfies anisotropic Type II bounds, and which is exactly axisymmetric on a ball around the axis at every time, is axisymmetric and regular at the putative singular point (Theorem 1.1); the axisymmetric theorem (Theorem 1.3), the meridional smallness proposition, the consequences for the force (Corollary 2.3) and the lemmas of Sections 3 and 5 are formalized with it. The interior analyticity theorem of Kahane, the interior estimates of Serrin and the regularity criterion of Gustafson, Kang and Tsai, in the forms the paper uses, are proved rather than assumed. The thirteen results use only the standard axioms and build on the Lean formalization of the Caffarelli-Kohn-Nirenberg theorem; five of them are restated in a Mathlib-only comparator challenge and proved from the library theorems.
